description:

description:
**Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate, Clean Energy**

The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) is inviting applications for the positions of Programme Lead and Senior Programme Associate under its Clean Energy Programme.

We are looking for experienced, motivated professionals with a strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, demonstrated analytical and research capabilities, and a proven track record in programme execution, advisory and implementation-oriented assignments. The role also requires excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder engagement skills to support high-impact clean energy transition initiatives across states and sectors.

https://forms.gle/Bujd7qyMMpFB2vFY8

Required Experience for
**Programme Lead**
: 10+ years

Required Experience for
**Senior Programme Associate**
: 5–7 years

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Reporting to: Director, Clean Energy (Programme Lead) / Programme Lead, Clean Energy (Senior Programme Associate)

**About iFOREST**

iFOREST is an independent, not-for-profit research and innovation organisation established in 2019. Our mission is to identify, promote and scale up solutions for critical environment-development challenges in India and other developing regions across Asia and Africa.

We focus on regional priorities to accelerate environmental action at the sub-national level, while influencing national policies and plans to support these efforts. By drawing on our resources and expertise, we aim to address regional needs, strengthen national action and contribute to global solutions.

Our work involves independent, evidence-based research, developing innovative solutions, convening stakeholders to build consensus, and partnering with think tanks, civil society organisations, government agencies, philanthropies and industry leaders.

**The Clean Energy Programme**

The iFOREST Clean Energy Programme focuses on accelerating equitable renewable energy growth in India by supporting clean energy deployment in underserved states, especially in the eastern and northeastern regions.

The programme supports state governments through policy and regulatory reform, implementation strategies, techno-economic assessments, investment facilitation and institutional capacity building. Its focus states include Odisha, Assam, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh. The work prioritises land-neutral technologies such as floating solar, agri-PV, rooftop solar, storage and green hydrogen.

**The Role**

The Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate will drive research, policy advisory and implementation activities under the Clean Energy Programme. The Programme Lead will anchor delivery of the programme, working closely with the Director across research, engagement, technical support and implementation, and will manage teams and workstreams. The Senior Programme Associate will lead the execution of key assignments, particularly on industrial renewable energy adoption, demand aggregation and investment mobilisation in Uttar Pradesh and other priority states.

The selected candidates will work closely with state governments, renewable energy agencies, utilities, industrial associations, MSMEs, development partners and other stakeholders to develop and implement renewable energy transition initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive execution of ongoing and planned projects, ensuring timely delivery of committed activities, outputs, milestones and reporting requirements
* Design and manage workplans, research methodologies, analytical frameworks and implementation strategies for programme assignments
* Conduct and oversee primary and secondary research, techno-economic assessments and policy analysis on industrial RE adoption, RE procurement, demand aggregation and storage integration
* Lead preparation of research reports, policy briefs, technical outputs, regulatory recommendations and investment-oriented strategies, with analytical rigour and quality control
* Support the design and operationalisation of RE demand aggregation initiatives and pilot projects in industrial clusters
* Build and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, utilities, industries, MSMEs, research institutions, CSOs, media and development partners
* Lead stakeholder consultations, workshops, trainings, convenings and field engagements
* Represent iFOREST in external meetings, consultations, conferences and sectoral discussions
* Contribute to programme development, including concept notes, technical proposals, budgets, pitch materials and partnership building
* Manage and mentor programme teams, supporting work allocation, progress tracking and capacity building (Programme Lead)
* Undertake any additional responsibilities related to the advancement of the Clean Energy Programme and institutional priorities

**Qualification & Work Experience**

At least a master’s degree from a recognised institution in a relevant field, such as energy policy, public policy, economics, management, renewable energy, engineering or a related discipline.

Around 10 years of relevant experience for the Programme Lead, and 5–7 years for the Senior Programme Associate, in research, strategy consulting, advisory, programme implementation or policy engagement focused on the renewable energy sector.

A demonstrated track record of producing high-quality research and advisory outputs, such as reports, briefs, assessments, presentations and implementation frameworks.

Experience of working with government agencies, utilities, industries, industry associations, development partners or research institutions will be an advantage.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, including its policies, regulations, programmes, technologies, industrial markets, open access, captive energy and implementation challenges
* Proven experience in qualitative and quantitative research, policy analysis and techno-economic assessments
* Strong programme execution and project management capabilities
* Ability to engage effectively with government, industry, research institutions, CSOs and development partners
* Strong analytical, writing, presentation, communication and problem-solving skills
* Collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with strong organisational and time-management skills
* Experience in proposal development, programme reporting and donor coordination is desirable
* Willingness to travel as required

**What We Offer**

At iFOREST, we provide an inclusive and supportive work environment. We are committed to professional development through education, training and capacity-building initiatives.

* Opportunity to contribute to high-impact clean energy transition and renewable energy deployment initiatives across India
* Exposure to policy processes, government engagement and technical advisory work

**What You Will Do**
The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, serves as a trusted partner within the First Line Information Technology Operational Risk (ITOR) group and is accountable for issue validation testing, risk and controls advisory, governance, and reporting across Global Technology and Operations (GTO). The role leads multiple concurrent validation and control reviews to assess whether remediation addresses root causes, controls are designed and operating effectively, and risk outcomes are sustainable. The individual partners with business and technology leaders identify emerging risks, shape risk strategies and remediation priorities, and strengthen risk and control inventories. The role assists with risk and control governance forums, develops meaningful metrics and executive reporting, communicates risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalates matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. The role also coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities, supports the Privacy team as needed, and provides leadership, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure work is completed in accordance with department and industry standards.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**
The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, leads the planning and execution of issue validation and control testing to confirm remediation addresses root causes and delivers sustainable outcomes. The role, as a risk advisor, partners with business and technology leaders to identify and assess emerging risks, shape risk strategies, clarify risk acceptance decisions, and align remediation priorities with enterprise standards and business objectives. The role strengthens the control environment by advising on control design, evaluating design and operating effectiveness, maintaining accurate risk and control inventories, identifying thematic gaps and trends, and driving clear ownership, monitoring, and timely remediation. The role also supports effective governance by facilitating risk and control forums, establishing meaningful metrics and reporting, communicating risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalating matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. It coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities across Global Technology and Operations, and supports the Privacy team with privacy-related risk assessments, incident response, data mapping, and privacy-by-design activities.
  
  

* Lead issue validation and testing engagements to confirm that root causes are addressed and remediation is sustainable.
* Plan and schedule validation reviews for open issues, prioritizing work based on risk, target closure dates, and validation readiness.
* Coordinate validation activities with issue owners, control design functions, First Line management, and Audit to confirm scope, evidence requirements, dependencies, and review timelines.
* Assess remediation evidence and control implementation to determine whether corrective actions address root causes and operate as intended.
* Track validation progress, resolve evidence gaps, and escalate delays or risks that could affect timely issue closure.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to assess technology, cyber, data, resilience, and third-party risks; shape risk strategies; and align risk acceptance and remediation decisions with enterprise standards and business objectives.
* Lead risk assessments, maintain accurate process, risk, control, and issue inventories, and analyze trends and control gaps to strengthen control design, monitoring, remediation, governance, and reporting.
* Coordinate responses to risk events and emerging issues with business, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and control partners; provide executive reporting and escalation; facilitate root-cause and after-action reviews; and track corrective actions through sustainable resolution.
* Remain current on industry developments in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, information security, third-party risk management, and resilience.
* Lead and execute engagements that meet the department’s methodologies and quality standards.
* Invest in professional development, educate others on key risks and controls, and support staff development, recruiting, performance management, and succession planning.

* Lead and support regulatory gap assessments and responses, SOC/SOX activities, and client assessments in partnership with Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders.

**What You Will Bring**

* 8+ years of relevant experience gained through a combination of information security/technology, risk and/or audit related roles, including leading complex engagements and managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Specifically, experience in cloud operations, cyber security operations, vulnerability management or other IT operation-based specialist roles.

* Strong knowledge of emerging topics and current analytical methods and techniques used to monitor and manage relevant risks.
* Track record of supervising, coaching, and developing talent; experience with work planning, staffing, and reviewing team deliverables for quality and consistency. Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience communicating complex topics to senior management and driving alignment on issues, ownership, and remediation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to leverage data, metrics, and analytics to inform scoping, testing strategy, and thematic insights.
